protocol_purpose: Post-hoc, zero-training decomposition of the frozen P27 AP/AUROC tradeoff.

N.name: NATIVE
N.definition: Frozen P26 native abnormal probability from each immutable P27 prediction artifact; no residual.

S.name: STUDENT
S.definition: Frozen P27 abnormal probability from each immutable P27 prediction artifact; never regenerated.

OP.name: HELD_PATCH_TEACHER_ORACLE
OP.definition: Held-GT post-hoc oracle: frozen Tier-A native logits, exact R0 signed utility, alpha=0.25, margin scale=19.840438842773438, abnormal-only shared patch correction. Not deployable.

OR.name: HELD_REGION_TEACHER_ORACLE
OR.definition: OP patch correction adaptively averaged 37x37 to 9x9, aligned-bilinearly reconstructed to 37x37, then applied as the P27 symmetric two-class residual. No learning.

frozen_semantics.r0_utility: negative gradient of calculate_seg_loss(deploy_with_delta(native, abnormal_only_shared_zero_correction), held_mask) * stage_count with respect to the shared patch correction
frozen_semantics.deployment: Industrial P26 deploy_native_logits: 7x7 Gaussian blur sigma=1.0, aligned bilinear resize to 518, mean over three stages, softmax

metrics.metric_definition: Exact float32 rank-group AP and AUROC with stable descending mergesort; tied scores use group-average pair credit for AUROC and group-end precision for AP, matching P27 exact_metrics.

ranking_diagnostics.pair_ordering: For every anomaly score and normal score, count orderings where anomaly > normal; compute gained, lost, and net versus N without materializing the Cartesian pair matrix. Exact ties are excluded from gained/lost and retain 0.5 AUROC credit.
ranking_diagnostics.top_rank_metric: anomaly fraction among the highest-scoring ceil(fraction * pixel_count) pixels, with stable descending order

alignment.teacher: OR 9x9 region target before reconstruction, shared across stages
alignment.student: P27 adapter output on frozen Tier-A seg_features for the held class, before reconstruction

exploratory_correlations.interpretation: exploratory only; no predictive selector or causal claim

hypotheses.H1: TEACHER_OBJECTIVE_CONFLICT: OP relative to N shows positive AP behavior with systematic AUROC degradation.
hypotheses.H2: REGIONIZATION_LOSS: OP is materially safer than OR in AUROC/ranking behavior.
hypotheses.H3: STUDENT_TRANSFER_FAILURE: OR retains useful oracle behavior but S loses it broadly.
hypotheses.H4: NORMAL_SCORE_INFLATION: S residuals raise the high-score normal tail more than they improve useful anomaly ordering.
hypotheses.H5: HETEROGENEOUS_CATEGORY_ACTIONABILITY: correction benefit is strongly category/regime dependent.

root_cause_rule: Use the complete N -> OP -> OR -> S decomposition mechanically; do not select from one class or from a single metric. If OP already has AP-up/AUROC-down, suspect teacher conflict; if OP is safe but OR loses ranking, suspect regionization; if OR remains useful but S loses it, suspect student transfer; if category dependence dominates without one transition, use heterogeneous or mixed; if evidence is inadequate, insufficient.
